verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI-like feature is the 'Describe your search' panel, which turns a natural-language description into an error search query. That is a narrow, single-purpose helper rather than a general assistant you can hand tasks to. The MCP server serves external AI assistants, not a built-in one, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in assistant/chat, delegation of multi-step tasks (triage, resolve, investigate), explicit documentation that the search panel is AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
